description: Publish videos to a connected YouTube channel

actions.description: Upload the post's video to the connected YouTube channel. The bytes are streamed from storage through a resumable upload session (YouTube cannot pull from a URL), so a failed attempt resumes rather than restarting. A publish_at schedules the video: it is uploaded private and YouTube makes it public at that instant.

params.work_item_id: Id of the Post whose uploaded video asset should be published (required unless asset_id is given)
params.asset_id: Id of a specific recorded video asset on that Post (optional; the Post's video is resolved automatically when omitted)
params.asset_ref: Storage reference of the video asset, as an alternative to asset_id (optional)
params.title: Video title, max 100 characters (required)
params.privacy_status: public, unlisted or private (optional; defaults to private, and is forced to private whenever publish_at is set)
params.publish_at: ISO-8601 instant to make the video public at (optional; requires privacy_status=private, and is silently ignored while the API project is unaudited)
params.target_id: Id of the post_publish_target this upload belongs to, used to resume an interrupted upload (optional)
params.idempotency_key: Key the upload's resume checkpoint is stored under, when the caller owns one of its own (optional)

actions.description: Take back a scheduled upload: re-privatize the video and clear its scheduled publish time. The video is stranded, not deleted, so a human can still recover it. A null publish_at clears the schedule; omitting it entirely would leave the scheduled publish standing.

params.video_id: Id of the video to re-privatize (required)
params.privacy_status: Privacy to park the video at (optional; defaults to private)
params.publish_at: ISO-8601 instant to reschedule the publish for, or null to clear the schedule (optional)

actions.description: Read back a video's current privacy on YouTube — whether a scheduled publish has actually made it public yet, and the watch permalink it is reachable at.

params.video_id: Id of the video to read back (required)
